title: dryopteris costata
intro: Dryopteris costata, commonly known as the toothed wood fern, is a species of fern in the wood fern family. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, and research has shown that it possesses several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects that can help to protect against cell damage and reduce the risk of chronic diseases. The therapeutic actions of D. costata include its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of D. costata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpene lactones, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant activities.
